description: This Java source file defines the `Answer` entity model class for a Spring Boot application using JPA/Hibernate. It maps to the 'answers' table in a relational database, includes fields for id and text, and establishes a many-to-one relationship with a `Question` entity, with appropriate annotations for ORM and JSON serialization.

classes.name: Answer
classes.description: Entity class representing an answer with a text and a relation to a question, extending an audit model for auditing purposes.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the answer.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the answer.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the text content of the answer.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text content of the answer.

methods.name: getQuestion
methods.description: Returns the question associated with this answer.

methods.name: setQuestion
methods.description: Associates this answer with a question.
